snippet.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: The Deluxe Collection | 1 year Anniversary Dev Commentary
snippet.description:
We've Been Deluxing for 1 whole year now!! I wasn't too sure what to do, So I quickly made this for the games birthday. I get a lil corny at the end lol, but I really do appreciate the support you guys have shown this game over the past year :]

https://gamejolt.com/games/FNaFDX/798798
